senses.gloss:
(ए) मथे r. 1st cl. (मथति)
1 To churn.
2 To stir or agitate.
(इ,) मथि (मन्थति)
1 To hurt or kill.
2 To afflict.
3 To suffer pain.

(इ) माथि r. 1st cl. (मांथति)
To hurt or kill, to afflict, to suffer pain.

m. (-थः)
1 Churning, stirring.
2 A road.
3 Hurting, injuring, killing.
E.
माथ to hurt, aff. अच् or मथ to agitate, aff. अण्.

n. (-नं)
Churning.
m. (-नः)
A tree, the wood of which is used to produce fire by attrition, (Premna longifolia.)
E.
मथ to churn, to stir or rub, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Stirred, churned.
2 Agitated, mentally, distressed, anxious.
n. (-तं)
Butter-milk, without any watery admixture.
E.
मथ to churn, aff. क्त.

m. (-न्था)
A churning stick.
E.
मथि to stir or agitate, aff. इन्, and the nasal rejected.

f. (-रा)
A town in the province of Agra, celebrated as the birth place, and early residence of KṚṢṆA, and still an object of pilgrimage amongst the Hindus.
E.
मथि to stir, Uṇādi aff. उरच्.

f. (-रा)
Mathurā as above.
E.
ऊरच् affixed to मथि, instead of उरच्.

m. (-शः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
मथुरा a town, and ईश ruler.
